requirements: target deployment is immutable, READY and belongs to canonical Vercel project
target deployment is explicitly marked last-known-good
target release commit differs from failing release commit
target application is verified compatible with the currently active schema
forward-fix candidate commit differs from failing release
C04 migration gate passed for exact forward-fix commit
isolated schema verification passed for exact forward-fix commit
backup source is identified and recovery point is recorded
data-loss boundary and storage-object recovery state are documented
explicit production recovery authorization exists before any destructive production action

safety_rules: Never roll back the database merely because an application rollback is requested.
Never treat a PostgreSQL restore as Supabase Storage/evidence-object recovery.
Never execute a production rollback/redeploy without the DAVID Vercel deployment lease when a Vercel action is required.
Never bypass authentication, MFA, CAPTCHA, provider permissions or approval gates.
Preserve audit/log/request-ID evidence before destructive recovery.
Prefer backward-compatible forward-fix migrations over destructive schema rollback.
remaining: C03 and C04 must be GREEN before C05 can be GREEN.
A real last-known-good production deployment must exist before application rollback can be drilled live.
Production backup mode/storage-object recovery coverage must meet R11 before a production data-recovery drill.
A live rollback/recovery drill must capture exact deployment/database evidence and post-recovery smoke checks.
